payload.reason: The evidence clearly indicates that the CNN-based model outperforms other models in various tasks, specifically achieving the highest macro-F1 scores in comparisons with RNN and BiLSTM models.

claims.text: A CNN-based sentence classifier achieved the best results in all three sub-tasks.
The CNN outperforms the RNN model, achieving a macro-F1 score of 0.80.
The CNN system achieved higher performance compared to the BiLSTM, with a macro-F1 score of 0.69.
